threshold_status: Temperature and acceptance thresholds fitted on 437 field validation images. Not a validated leaf detector.
limitations: Single-label 38-class classifier; no simultaneous-disease or severity prediction.
Field test accuracy 65.25%; accepted predictions 85.88% accuracy at 36.02% coverage.
Only three non-leaf smoke inputs tested; this is not validated open-world plant identification.
Unsupported crops and heavily transformed duplicates remain limitations.
Local CPU memory is not production hosting peak memory.
